Controller edits / agent access
|-- MappingDocumentController public boundary
|   |-- getSnapshot(); nodes(); subscribe(listener)
|   |-- The controller manages current document/canvas state and cached display nodes
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact delegates to applyUpdate
|   |-- Version checks and a 1-100 operation limit precede edits to a cloned snapshot
|   |-- updateCanvas(value, record=false); select(command); commitDocument(document)
|   `-- Recorded updates append history; transient layout changes need not advance it
|-- Internal edit coordination
|   |-- prepareDiagramEdit -> diagrams.revise(staged revisionId, edit) [call]
|   |-- Patch correspondence reanchors edges, jumps, folded nodes and section lines
|   |-- diagram-revision-apply -> receiveDiagramRevision(expectedRevisionId, revision)
|   |-- Applying a generated revision checks that the current revision still matches
|   |-- diagram-create / diagram-insert -> insertGridDiagram -> layoutScene [calls]
|   |-- grid: move | collapse | group | remove; floating: move | collapse | remove
|   |-- Grid moves require cells; floating moves require finite pixel coordinates
|   |-- collapse + contentNodeId -> diagramViews [operation sketch]
|   |-- Subtree collapse requires a known tree node with children
|   |-- delete-diagrams prunes selected boxes, unused content and related selections
|   |-- edge-create / edge-update -> schema.parse, validateConnectionAnchor [calls]
|   |-- updateSnapshot reconciles connections, normalizes views and resolves geometry
|   `-- updateSnapshot(record=true) -> historyService.append(..., pendingNodeIds) [call]
|-- Display and history dependencies
|   |-- nodes() -> canvasDisplayNodes(document, canvas, version, cell, endpointBounds)
|   |-- Node results are cloned; endpoint measurements are validated
|   |-- undo / reset -> historyService.navigate / reset [calls]
|   `-- The context handle refers to service-managed history
`-- Agent transport and page command adapter
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(descriptor, handle, workspace?)
    |-- The hook manages registration, polling, abort cleanup and mutation receipts
    |-- command delivery -> latest.current.handle(command) -> reply [call sketch]
    |-- Context reads are fresh; non-context receipts are cached up to 200 entries
    |-- publishLiveCanvasSelections(workspace, canvasId, endpoint, setAgentStatus)
    |-- handleAgentCommand('context') returns version, name, nodes and cloned edges
    |-- handleAgentCommand('snapshot') -> getSnapshot(), exportHistory() [calls]
    |-- handleAgentCommand('apply') -> controller.applyUpdate(...) [call]
    |-- The page caches apply/create/copy request receipts and rejects busy edits
    `-- Revision reception uses a supplied persistence sync-and-flush callback
